title: pycreus globosus var. nilagiricus
intro: Pycreus globosus var. nilagiricus, commonly known as Nilagiri Pycreus, is a species of plant in the sedge family, Cyperaceae. It is a perennial, grass-like plant that is native to the Western Ghats in India. The health benefits of Nilagiri Pycreus include its potential anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce inflammation, prevent infections, and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities.
